solver_compatibility_note: explicit recoat rows require --recoat-time 0; --dt equals the first row dt; `layer` = 1-based activation slab; --layers = slab count; --layer-thickness = slab thickness; per-row `power` is the commanded flash power of that layer
coordinate_frame: mesh coordinates (raft bottom at z = 0, part base at z = raft height)

flash.power_rule: commanded(layer) = P x t_scan(layer) / (t_flash x capture(slab))

activation_rule: activate a 200 um slab when its first contained 40 um physical-layer flash starts
